strings.zh: 常見的 TKI / 標靶藥物有哪些？
strings.en: What TKIs / targeted therapies are commonly used?

strings.zh: CTCAE 嚴重度分級（共通分級）
手足皮膚反應（Hand-Foot Skin Reaction, HFSR）
預防策略 — 開始用藥前後該做的事
strings.en: Prevention strategy — what to do before and after starting therapy

strings.zh: 標靶藥物的痘痘可以用一般治痘痘藥膏嗎？
strings.en: Can ordinary acne creams treat targeted-therapy acneiform rash?

strings.zh: 皮膚反應越強代表標靶藥物越有效嗎？
strings.en: Does a stronger skin reaction mean the targeted therapy is more effective?

strings.zh: 標靶藥物的皮膚副作用會自己好嗎？停藥後多久消失？
strings.en: Do skin side effects resolve on their own? How long after discontinuation?

strings.zh: 看皮膚科健保有給付嗎？
strings.en: Does NHI cover dermatology consultations for these effects?

strings.zh: 我聽說 EGFR 痘痘可以擦類固醇，會不會更糟？
strings.en: I heard topical steroids can be used for EGFR acneiform rash — won't they make it worse?

strings.zh: 有沒有口服藥可以預防痤瘡樣皮疹？
strings.en: Is there an oral medication that prevents acneiform rash?

strings.zh: TLCS + TDA 2024 共識涵蓋衛福部核准的 8 類 TKI 與標靶藥物。常見藥物與機轉：
strings.en: The TLCS + TDA 2024 consensus covers 8 classes of MOHW-approved TKIs and targeted agents. Common agents and mechanisms:

strings.zh: 用藥 6 個月以上，發生率約 8-30%。特徵：
strings.en: Incidence ~8–30% after 6 months on therapy. Features:

strings.zh: 皮膚副作用獲得良好控制，癌症治療才能延續完整療程，提升整體存活與生活品質。
strings.en: Good control of skin side effects allows cancer therapy to continue at full course, improving overall survival and quality of life.

strings.zh: 分布：臉部（尤其鼻部、額頭）、頸部、上胸、上背
strings.en: Distribution: face (especially nose, forehead), neck, upper chest, upper back
Often accompanied by stinging, itching, and dryness

strings.zh: 洗澡溫水（不超過 38°C），選無皂鹼、無香料的洗浴用品
strings.en: Bathe in lukewarm water (≤ 38°C); use soap-free, fragrance-free cleansers

strings.zh: 選擇寬鬆鞋襪，避免緊身鞋擠壓
strings.en: Wear loose footwear; avoid tight shoes that compress feet

strings.zh: 嚴重者口服抗生素（若有真細菌感染）
strings.en: Oral antibiotics for severe cases (if true bacterial infection)

strings.zh: 不同於化療造成的「手足症候群」（那是 5-FU、Capecitabine 引起的瀰漫性紅斑）
strings.en: Different from chemotherapy-induced "hand-foot syndrome" (diffuse erythema from 5-FU, capecitabine)

strings.zh: 急性期：外用強效類固醇 + 高濃度尿素霜，水泡需保護不戳破
strings.en: Acute phase: high-potency topical steroid + high-concentration urea cream; protect blisters intact

strings.zh: Grade 2-3 暫停 TKI，恢復至 ≤ Grade 1 後減量恢復
strings.en: Grade 2–3: hold TKI; resume at reduced dose after recovery to ≤ grade 1

strings.zh: 用藥前充分衛教，知道會有什麼變化
strings.en: Pre-therapy patient education on expected changes

strings.zh: 輕度副作用立即處理，別累積到嚴重才急著看皮膚科
strings.en: Treat mild side effects promptly; don't wait until severe to see dermatology

strings.zh: 跨科合作 — 腫瘤科 / 胸腔科 / 皮膚科共同照護
strings.en: Multidisciplinary care — oncology / pulmonology / dermatology coordination

strings.zh: 不可自行停藥 — 與醫師討論調整方案
strings.en: Never self-discontinue — discuss dose adjustment with physician

strings.zh: 不只影響生活品質，更可能讓患者中斷治療
strings.en: not only affect QoL but may force treatment discontinuation

strings.zh: 臺灣肺癌學會 (TLCS) + 臺灣皮膚科醫學會 (TDA) 2024 共識
strings.en: Taiwan Lung Cancer Society (TLCS) + Taiwanese Dermatological Association (TDA) 2024 Consensus
EGFR inhibitors (gefitinib, erlotinib, afatinib, osimertinib, etc.)

strings.zh: 「皮疹強度」與「腫瘤反應」呈正相關
strings.en: Rash intensity correlates positively with tumor response

strings.zh: CTCAE（Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events）分級 v5.0
strings.en: CTCAE v5.0 (Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events)

strings.zh: EGFR 抑制劑最常見、最具代表性的副作用
strings.en: the most common and characteristic adverse effect of EGFR inhibitors

strings.zh: 神經醯胺、玻尿酸、凡士林
外用強效類固醇 + 抗生素藥膏
角化斑塊、水泡、疼痛、皸裂
用藥前 1-2 週開始預防
strings.en: Begin preventive measures 1–2 weeks before therapy
Active prevention is superior to reactive treatment

strings.zh: 第一次出現皮膚副作用即就醫
strings.en: Seek medical attention at first sign of skin side effects

strings.zh: 外用 A 酸、過氧化苯醯（BPO）會加重乾燥與刺激
strings.en: Topical retinoids and benzoyl peroxide (BPO) worsen dryness and irritation

strings.zh: 沒有嚴重皮疹不代表藥物無效
strings.en: Absence of severe rash does NOT mean the drug is ineffective

strings.zh: 正確處理皮膚副作用，讓治療能延續
strings.en: Proper management of skin side effects allows treatment continuation

strings.zh: 停藥後 2-8 週內逐漸消失
strings.en: Gradually resolves within 2–8 weeks after discontinuation

strings.zh: 不應為了「等它自己好」而中斷治療
strings.en: Should NOT interrupt therapy waiting for spontaneous resolution

strings.zh: 診察、檢查、外用藥（類固醇、抗生素藥膏）、口服藥（Doxycycline、抗組織胺、口服類固醇）健保都有給付
strings.en: NHI covers visits, workup, topicals (steroids, antibiotic creams), and oral medications (doxycycline, antihistamines, oral steroids)

strings.zh: 類固醇藥膏可有效抑制發炎
可從用藥第 1 天起預防性給予口服 Doxycycline 100 mg/day
strings.en: Prophylactic oral doxycycline 100 mg/day can be started from day 1 of therapy

strings.zh: 可預期、可處理、不應中斷治療
strings.en: Predictable, manageable, should not interrupt therapy

strings.zh: TKI 標靶藥物相關皮膚毒性的預防與管理共識
strings.en: TKI-Targeted Therapy Cutaneous Toxicity Prevention and Management Consensus

strings.zh: 依 TLCS + TDA 2024 共識 · 更新 2026-05-04
痤瘡樣皮疹、乾皮症、甲溝炎、手足症
strings.en: Acneiform rash, xerosis, paronychia, hand-foot syndrome

strings.zh: 網站內容更正 / 學術引用詢問 / 媒體合作請寄：
strings.en: Content corrections / academic citation inquiries / media partnerships:

strings.zh: 痤瘡樣皮疹、乾皮症、甲溝炎

strings.en: Colorectal cancer, head and neck cancer
Hepatocellular carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, GIST

strings.zh: 光敏感、皮疹、第二原發皮膚癌
較少見，光敏感、視覺異常
外用 Clindamycin 1% / Erythromycin 2% + 弱中效類固醇藥膏（短期）
strings.en: Topical clindamycin 1% / erythromycin 2% + low-mid potency topical corticosteroid (short-term)

strings.zh: 暫停 TKI 直到 ≤ Grade 2,恢復時減量
strings.en: Hold TKI until ≤ grade 2; resume at reduced dose

strings.zh: 口服 Doxycycline + 中強效類固醇藥膏 + 必要時短期口服類固醇
strings.en: Oral doxycycline + mid-high potency topical steroid + short-course oral steroid if needed

strings.zh: 0.9% 生理食鹽水 / 碳酸氫鈉漱口、Chlorhexidine 漱口水、benzydamine 鎮痛漱口、塗局部麻醉劑(viscous lidocaine)
strings.en: 0.9% saline / sodium bicarbonate rinse, chlorhexidine mouthwash, benzydamine analgesic rinse, viscous lidocaine

strings.zh: 暫停 TKI 直到 ≤ Grade 2
加上局部 / 全身性類固醇，考慮預防真菌(Nystatin、Fluconazole)、病毒(Acyclovir)、細菌感染
strings.en: Add topical / systemic corticosteroids; consider antifungal prophylaxis (nystatin, fluconazole), antiviral (acyclovir), and antibacterial coverage

strings.zh: 住院支持治療，排除 Stevens-Johnson syndrome
strings.en: Inpatient supportive care; rule out Stevens-Johnson syndrome
